title: Jubilant Polish Basil Tagine
description: A low‑carb, aerated umami dish that blends Polish comfort with Thai sweet basil horapa in a tagine, perfect for midnight cravings.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy‑bottomed tagine or deep skillet over medium heat and sear the chicken until browned on all sides.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic, ginger, smoked paprika, and cumin, sautéing until fragrant, 1 minute.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and horapa sauce, stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Just before serving, fold in the fresh basil leaves until wilted, about 1 minute.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste, then transfer to a serving dish.
Garnish with extra basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil if desired.
Serve immediately with a side of cauliflower rice or a light salad for a balanced low‑carb meal.
Enjoy the aromatic, aerated umami burst that satisfies midnight cravings.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
